reason: Ranking reflects proposal distinctness, plausible timed-work reduction, and implementation risk; every result remains unverified. transpose_fusion is first because a small tile held in ZA could avoid full scratch roundtrips, though repeated transposition and additional ZA transfers may erase that benefit. a_transpose also targets packing cost but has material lifetime and traversal risks. The C-store regrouping and operand-schedule changes are narrower; packing B adds timed work despite contiguous existing loads. Store-form and direct ZA-store proposals need exact assembler legality established. Existing 64x32 traversal is already present, and cache-conflict and prefetch benefits lack evidence of a bottleneck.
